title: Improving Multivariate Time Series Classification with Class-Wise Training and Model Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we propose a class-wise dimension (channel) selection framework for Multivariate Time Series Classification (MTSC). Rather than applying a single global dimension selection process, the proposed approach independently identifies informative dimensions for each class. A dedicated learning process is subsequently performed for each class, followed by a fusion stage for final prediction. The objective is to improve the generation of discriminative feature representations while reducing the influence of noisy or non-informative dimensions. The proposed framework is evaluated using MiniRocket, a random kernel-based baseline method. Experimental results indicate that class-wise dimension selection improves the quality of extracted representations and can enhance classification performance, particularly in high-dimensional settings. translated_title: 通过逐类训练与模型聚合改进多元时间序列分类
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种用于多元时间序列分类（MTSC）的逐类维度（通道）选择框架。与采用单一全局维度选择过程不同，所提出的方法为每个类别独立识别信息丰富的维度，随后为每个类别执行专门的学习过程，最后通过融合阶段得到最终预测结果。该方法旨在提升判别性特征表示的生成质量，同时降低噪声或无信息维度的影响。该框架使用MiniRocket（一种基于随机核的基线方法）进行评估。实验结果表明，逐类维度选择提高了所提取表示的质量，并能增强分类性能，尤其在高维场景下效果显著。这些发现表明，将类别特定信息融入训练过程具有积极意义。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种逐类维度选择与模型聚合框架，为多元时间序列分类中的每个类别独立筛选信息丰富的维度并进行专门学习后再融合预测，从而提升判别性特征表示质量与分类性能，尤其在高维场景中效果突出。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a class-wise dimension selection and model aggregation framework for multivariate time series classification that independently identifies informative dimensions for each class with dedicated learning followed by fusion, improving discriminative feature representations and classification performance, especially in high-dimensional settings.
